description: Searches the Leonida Lab database of the released game, GTA 6 (Grand Theft Auto VI): the answers to what players ask (how to save, how to lose the police), vehicles, weapons, animals, safes and locks with their codes, radio stations, cheat codes, controls, ways to make money, trophies and the 100% list. The kind argument takes answer, vehicle, weapon, animal, safe, radio, cheat, control, money, trophy, completion. Every hit has a one-line answer and the page to cite, and, except a story spoiler, its status (Confirmed, Confirmed in the released game or Not confirmed yet); a story spoiler is flagged and never summarised, and has no status. Call get_entry for the whole row. A miss lists what is covered, and says when story answers are held back. Unofficial: Leonida Lab is not affiliated with Rockstar Games or Take-Two.

kind.description: Only this kind of entry. Omit it to search every kind.

query.description: What you want to know, in a few words: "how do I save", "lose the police", "keep a stolen car".

name: search_database
title: Search the GTA 6 database
